paragraphs: Order deliveries pan India, occur within 3 - 5 working days. We offer free shipping on all our prepaid orders (Domestic Orders).
For international orders, deliveries may take up to 18-20 working days.
Orders are set to sail within 24 - 48 working hours. Some orders can take longer, such as pre-order items.

sections.heading: At the time of order delivery!
paragraphs: If you think you have received the product in a poor condition or if the packaging is tampered with or damaged before delivery, please deny the delivery and do not accept the order. Also, connect with our care team mentioning your order ID and we will ensure that a brand-new replacement is issued to you with no additional cost.

sections.heading: Payment Method
paragraphs: You can pay via all major VISA or RazorPay credit/debit cards using our payment gateway at the time of checkout. Payment is accepted only in INR (Indian National Rupee) at the time of your purchase. Duties and taxes are included in the price itself.

sections.heading: When do I have to self ship the product to Palmonas?
paragraphs: Though a specific courier may deliver products to your address, they may not have the service for reverse pick up facility. In such cases you will have to ship the product back to us. Connect with our care team, we will share the address for return.
